use `String(error)` fallback). ### 7. `components/marketing/CampaignConfirmDialog.tsx` — NEW - shadcn AlertDialog. - Triggered from drawer's bottom Send/Schedule button. - Body shows: campaign name · recipient count · subject line · send time (or "Now") · iframe with email body preview. - CTA label dynamic: `Send now to {N} recipients` OR `Schedule for {date}`. - Confirm → POSTs to `/api/marketing/campaigns/{id}/send` (or schedule equivalent). ## Files to modify ### `components/marketing/CampaignEditor.tsx` — FULL REBUILD Read first. - **Cut all 3 Status dropdowns** (steps 1, 4, 5). Status is derived. Existing `status` schema column kept; UI never sets it. Default to `draft` on new, server promotes to `scheduled`/`sending`/`sent` on actions. - **Cut step stepper + Next/Back navigation.** All sections render in a single scrolling drawer. - **Section 1 — Details:** - Name field (keep) - Type dropdown — drop entirely if only `manual` exists; keep with comment if `automated` ships M6+. Inspect schema and make the call. M6 didn't add automation, so drop the type dropdown for v1. - Channel — already filtered to email-only in M1. Keep. - **Section 2 — Audience:** - Render `` above existing AudienceFilterBuilder. - Keep AudienceFilterBuilder as power-user fallback labelled "Custom segment". - Always render live "Sending to N recipients" header above the section (currently conditional — make unconditional). - **Section 3 — Template:** - Render `` first. - Replace plain Textarea body with ``. - Subject field: keep. - Add `` and `` panes (preview right, editor left, on desktop; stacked on mobile). - **Section 4 — Schedule:** - Replace "Send date (optional)" datetime-local with explicit RadioGroup: `Send now` | `Schedule for later`. - Schedule path reveals datetime picker + label `" · Studio time ()"` — pull tz from `studios.timezone` via session. - Add Recurring Switch with select: daily / weekly / monthly. Schema column `recurrence_rule` (text RRULE) — confirm if column exists; if not, store as JSONB `metadata.recurrence` for now and document for M6 follow-up. - **Bottom action bar:** - Replace step nav with sticky footer: `Cancel` (closes drawer) · `Send/Schedule` (opens ``). CTA verb dynamic: "Send now" or "Schedule for {date}". ### `components/marketing/AudienceFilterBuilder.tsx` — extend - Currently AND-only. - Add OR + NOT operators. Schema for `audience_filter` JSONB grows to `{ groups: [{ op: "AND"|"OR", conditions: [...] }], exclude: [...] }`. - UI: top of builder lets user add a "group" (AND or OR), each group contains conditions. Below the groups: "Exclude" section for NOT (e.g. "exclude unsubscribed"). - Save legacy flat shape under `groups: [{ op: "AND", conditions: }]` for backward compat reads. - Live recipient count via existing `/api/marketing/campaigns/audience-count` route — that route now points at the updated RPC accepting both shapes. ### `app/(app)/marketing/page.tsx` - Mount `` globally (not tab-scoped) so it can open from any tab via `?campaign=new`. - Connect page-header `+ New campaign` button to set the URL param. ### `app/(app)/marketing/campaigns/new/page.tsx` - Keep file (some bookmarks may exist) — change to a Server Component that redirects to `/marketing?campaign=new&segment=` preserving any query params. ## API routes to create ### 1. `app/api/marketing/segments/route.ts` GET. Calls `get_marketing_segment_counts(studio_id)` RPC. Returns `{ all, inactive_90d, new_30d, top_spenders, birthday_month, booked_next_14d, unsubscribed }`. Auth required (Supabase server client). Rate-limit: `apiRatelimit`. ### 2. `app/api/marketing/templates/route.ts` GET. Reads `marketing_templates` table. Returns 5 rows. ### 3. `app/api/marketing/campaigns/test-send/route.ts` POST. Body: `{ subject: string, body: string, channel: "email" }`. - Validates with Zod. - Pulls `auth.user.email` from session. - Sends via existing `lib/email/resend.ts` wrapper to that email only. - Renders the HTML body w/ merge tags resolved using session user's first_name + studio_name. - 5/min rate limit per user (use `apiRatelimit`). - Returns `{ ok: true }` or `{ error: }`. - Errors must always serialize to a string in the JSON response — never let `[object Object]` leak. ### 4. (Optional) `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/test-send/route.ts` POST. Loads campaign by id, then calls the same logic as above using campaign's saved subject/body. ## Quality gates - `pnpm typecheck` — zero NEW errors. Pre-existing errors documented in M1 report — leave alone. - `pnpm build` — succeeds (or surfaces same pre-existing failures only). - Brand: Bone bg, Onyx CTAs, Stone secondary, **Rust earned (only on the live recipient count badge OR the active segment chip — pick one, not both)**. - shadcn primitives only — no custom Sheet/Dialog rolls. - TipTap install: `pnpm add @tiptap/react @tiptap/pm @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-link @tiptap/extension-image` — confirm versions don't conflict. - No `any`. No raw hex. No `shadow-md`. - Drawer focus trap, Esc close (shadcn Sheet handles this — verify). - Toast errors NEVER render `[object Object]` — use `String(error)` or `error.message ?? "Something went wrong"` fallback. Add a `toast.error()` wrapper utility in `lib/toast.ts` if needed that always coerces to string. ## Out of scope for M2 - Audience tab full UI (M3). - Waitlist tab (M4). - Referrals rebuild (M5). - Sending the actual scheduled campaigns through worker (M6 worker extension is in M3 if needed; for M2 the schedule just persists, worker behavior already exists). ## Verify before reporting done 1. `pnpm typecheck` — no NEW errors vs M1 baseline. 2. `pnpm build` — surfaces only pre-existing failures. 3. Mental walkthrough: - /marketing → click "+ New campaign" → drawer opens with all 4 sections visible. - Click "Inactive 90d" chip → audience prefilled, recipient count badge shows live count. - Switch to Template section → 5 starter templates render → click "We miss you" → editor fills. - Send test → email arrives at logged-in user's inbox. - Schedule radio → pick "Schedule for later" → datetime picker reveals with timezone label. - Click bottom Send/Schedule → confirm dialog shows correct preview → CTA reads "Send now to 8 recipients". 4. No `[object Object]` toasts possible — error path tested. Report: files created/modified with line ranges, list of API routes added, TipTap deps installed, typecheck/build last 10 lines, blockers.

42	function makeUpstashLimiter(
43	  requests: number,
44	  windowSeconds: number,
45	  name: string,
46	): Limiter {
47	  const url = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL
48	  const token = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
49	
50	  if (!url || !token) {
51	    return makeNoop(name)
52	  }
53	
54	  // Sliding window via Upstash REST API — no Node.js SDK dependency needed.
55	  // Uses the MULTI/EXEC pattern: INCR + EXPIRE in one round-trip.
56	  return {
57	    async limit(identifier: string): Promise<RateLimitResponse> {
58	      const key = `rl:${name}:${identifier}`
59	      const now = Date.now()
60	      const windowMs = windowSeconds * 1_000
61	
62	      try {
63	        // Pipeline: INCR key + EXPIRE key windowSeconds
64	        const pipelineRes = await fetch(`${url}/pipeline`, {
65	          method: 'POST',
66	          headers: {
67	            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
68	            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
69	          },
70	          body: JSON.stringify([
71	            ['INCR', key],
72	            ['EXPIRE', key, windowSeconds],
73	          ]),
74	        })
75	
76	        if (!pipelineRes.ok) {
77	          logger.warn({ name, status: pipelineRes.status }, 'rate-limit: Upstash pipeline error — allowing request')
78	          return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining: requests, reset: now + windowMs }
79	        }
80	
81	        const results = await pipelineRes.json() as [{ result: number }, { result: number }]
82	        const count = results[0].result
83	
84	        const remaining = Math.max(0, requests - count)
85	        const reset = now + windowMs
86	
87	        if (count > requests) {
88	          return { success: false, limit: requests, remaining: 0, reset }
89	        }
90	
91	        return { success: true, limit: requests, remaining, reset }
92	      } catch (err) {

94	        logger.error({ err, name }, 'rate-limit: Redis error — failing open')
